G3.rule: fp64 fused-kernel rule on the code's own |bulk| (captured fp32 absr): visible & |bulk| >= mean + z*std over visible keys, population std; z = quant._norm_ppf(1-0.15)
G3.metric: agreement = mean over visible (row,col) of [code refine mask == rule mask]
G3.gate: >= 0.999 per cell for A+B; before and A agreement reported
G3.cells: G2 quant.py synthetic grid (all dtype cases) + every G4 real-data cell
G3.kernel_diag: tc._C.bp_kernel_4_diagnostic variants 'a' (shipped apa_selective_fwd_train + a_mask) and 'h' (BK4) on real captures with one query head per KV head (kq shared): agreement of each arm's quant.py mask vs the kernel mask, reported (not gated)

G4_real.rows: last L query rows against all S keys
G4_real.operands: bf16 exact (raw bits); K/V expanded to query heads (GQA repeat, head h -> kv h//(Hq/KVH)); calls in groups of 8 query heads (rotation tables indexed within the group, identical across arms)
metrics: output rel err ||out-ref||_F/||ref||_F and max-abs vs fp64 exact attention

G4_grm.model: Qwen3-1.7B bf16, GRM core/qwen3_1p7b_tc.Qwen3_1p7b_TC.from_pretrained (bulk_bits 8 as GRM sets it), read-only GRM import, engine = this worktree (asserted)
G4_grm.text: wikitext-2-raw-v1 test parquet (local HF cache), ''.join(text), tokenized without special tokens, first 8192+33 ids
G4_grm.chunked: prefill 16 chunks of 512 with KV cache, then 32 teacher-forced single-token steps (feed ids[8192+j])
G4_grm.metrics: per step KL(P_standard || P_arm) and top-1 agreement over the 32 teacher-forced step distributions (prefill-final reported separately)
G4_grm.control: unchunked prefill (S == L) of the first 4096 tokens (fallback 2048 on OOM; 8192 unchunked does not fit 12 GiB in the composed apa path) then 32 teacher-forced steps; A logits must equal before bytewise
